title: This Software Stock Is Up 74% in 1 Month, and It Can Keep Climbing Higher From Here
excerpt: Artificial intelligence is pushing its recurring revenue and backlog to new records.
content_html:
Software stocks crashed at the start of 2026 amid growing fears that artificial intelligence would disrupt the growth of many enterprise software providers. But as many software companies seek to set themselves apart from the pack by demonstrating that AI benefits their businesses, the group has begun to recover.

Atlassian (NASDAQ: TEAM), for example, is up 74% over the past month, as of this writing. Even after that phenomenal growth, the stock has yet to recover its share price from the start of the year. What's more, it remains about 50% below its all-time high from the start of 2025.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

But Atlassian looks poised to use its broad software suite and AI to drive higher financial results, and its stock price should follow suit. It can still climb much higher from here.

What's driving the stock higher, and can it keep it up?

Shares of Atlassian have benefited from a broader rotation from chipmakers to software stocks, but its rise was fueled by much better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings. The company grew revenue 28% year over year, driven by strong results from its cloud segment, which accelerated to 31% year-over-year revenue growth.

That's important because the company is migrating customers from on-premises data center deployments to its cloud platform by 2029. Management pulled forward a lot of data center revenue into the third quarter and expects a significant drop-off in sales over the next year. Management's full-year outlook calls for a 17% decline in data center revenue, resulting in an overall 13% deceleration in 2027.

But Atlassian could outperform that guidance. It's worth noting that management expects its cloud revenue growth to come in at just 25.5% for the full year. That would suggest a considerable slowdown in the back half of the fiscal year.

That's despite management indicating very strong trends with its cloud customers, especially those using its AI platform, Rovo. Management said Rovo adopters are growing their annualized recurring revenue at twice the rate of non-adopters. Expanding Rovo's usage and driving adoption should help push more cloud revenue growth from its existing user base.

Management also continues to see solid performance in retention and expanding usage across teams within an organization. Net revenue retention exceeded 120%. What's more, the growth runway looks strong, with remaining performance obligations climbing 44% to $4.8 billion.

content_html_zh:
由于人们越来越担心人工智能会扰乱许多企业软件提供商的增长，软件股票在 2026 年初暴跌。 但随着许多软件公司试图通过证明人工智能有利于他们的业务来使自己脱颖而出，该集团已经开始复苏。

例如，截至撰写本文时，Atlassian（纳斯达克股票代码：TEAM）在过去一个月上涨了 74%。 即使在经历了如此惊人的增长之后，该股的股价也尚未恢复到年初的水平。 更重要的是，自 2025 年初以来，该价格仍比历史高点低约 50%。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

但 Atlassian 似乎准备利用其广泛的软件套件和人工智能来推动更高的财务业绩，其股价也应该效仿。 它仍然可以从这里爬得更高。

是什么推动股价走高？它能否保持这种势头？

Atlassian 的股价受益于从芯片制造商到软件股的更广泛轮动，但其上涨是由远好于预期的第四季度收益推动的。 在云业务强劲业绩的推动下，该公司收入同比增长 28%，收入同比增长加速至 31%。

这很重要，因为该公司将在 2029 年之前将客户从本地数据中心部署迁移到其云平台。 管理层将大量数据中心收入推迟到第三季度，并预计明年的销售额将大幅下降。 管理层的全年展望预计数据中心收入将下降 17%，导致 2027 年总体下降 13%。

但 Atlassian 的表现可能会超越这一指导。 值得注意的是，管理层预计全年云收入增长仅为 25.5%。 这意味着本财年后半段经济增速将大幅放缓。

尽管管理层表明其云客户的趋势非常强劲，尤其是那些使用其人工智能平台 Rovo 的客户。 管理层表示，Rovo 采用者的年化经常性收入增长速度是未采用者的两倍。 扩大 Rovo 的使用并推动采用应该有助于推动其现有用户群的云收入增长。

管理层还继续看到组织内各团队在保留和扩大使用方面的稳健表现。 净收入留存率超过120%。 更重要的是，增长势头看起来很强劲，剩余履约义务增长了 44%，达到 48 亿美元。
